note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 5 June 1958. Two contests, Ballymaconaghy and Holywood Rural (Belfast News-Letter, 6 June 1958, p. 5; Irish News, 6 June 1958, p. 1). Unopposed returns: Ballyhackamore (William Geary; the sitting member withdrew) and Castlereagh (John Johnston); no nomination for Craigavad, whose retiring member Thomas Gray was deemed re-elected (Northern Whig and Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1958). The Whig says the six other retiring members were returned unopposed; four of them (Ballycultra, Ballymiscaw, Dundonald, Gilnahirk) are not named in the sources searched (round 2, 7 Nov 2026). New member for the division; the previous member was W. Mawhinney, chairman of the council. Johnston had been co-opted to the council in June 1955. Returned unopposed.
